{{Quote|Kral, in the force we lost&hellip;did you have any family?''"<br />"''Yes, sir. My son Turl. An ensign. A weapons officer aboard the frigate ''Cheesmeer''.|[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], inquiring about the destruction of the Second Fleet, and Kral Nevil|<ref name="Fury" />}}
The '''''Cheesmeer''''' was a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] assigned to the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Second Fleet]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]]<ref name="Fury" /> and active in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Fury" /> The frigate was present for a [[Battle of the rendezvous point|skirmish]] between a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[decoy fleet]], led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hoclaw]] of the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Force]], and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] forces, led by [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Tarla Limpan]], at a rendezvous point in [[Realspace/Legends|deep-space]]. The frigate, along with most of the Galactic Alliance Second Fleet and the entire Corellian decoy fleet, was destroyed by a blast launched from [[Centerpoint Station]], an ancient [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] that was armed with a powerful [[hyperspace tractor beam]], the firing of which was authorized by [[Five World Prime Minister]] [[Sadras Koyan]].<ref name="Fury" />

[[Turl Nevil]], son of former [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Kral Nevil]], served as a [[Weapons officer/Legends|weapons officer]] with the rank of [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] aboard the ''Cheesmeer''. Turl [[Death/Legends|perished]] alongside the entire crew of the frigate during the engagement.<ref name="Fury" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Cheesmeer'' was mentioned in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]].<ref name="Fury" />
